explicit_rule: Störmer–Verlet for mass-weighted pressure u''=-A u with zero initial derivative. Set dt=output_interval/ceil(output_interval*c_max/(CFL*h)); every output coincides with a time step. The sparse five-point A is applied to all three source columns.
norm: Equal-weight Frobenius norm over all output times, receivers, and source columns; include t=0. Also retain each source error.
timing_policy: Three sequential independent constructions per candidate after a shared small-case warm-up. Report the median of complete per-repetition totals, not the sum of stage medians. Include setup, basis, projection, propagation, and the requested output. Exclude diagnostic errors, reference evaluation, file I/O, and source generation quadrature defining the interface problem.
smooth_output: Receiver output only. Reconstructing full fields is not required or charged.
interface_output: Report receiver-only and receiver-plus-physical-pressure-field costs separately; joint receiver and field tolerances use the latter.
selection: Candidates and tolerances are fixed. Choose the least expensive tested candidate meeting the error threshold against the stated reference. Report unattained tolerances. The smooth-grid comparison is a finite-reference error.
rational_krylov: Use exactly the 12 cyclic shifts, damping 0.2, last-three-vector sequence, double reorthogonalization, and source conditioning from accuracy_cost/config.json. Build each requested rank independently.
dimension: r=n+2*m for both reduced methods; all n^2 pressure degrees of freedom for full methods.
chebyshev_rule: Even Chebyshev–Bessel polynomial for cos(t sqrt(A)); Gershgorin spectral bound and analytic uniform tail bound, shared verified implementation in propagation/chebyshev_reference.py. Include assembly and all output production.
